newsitem.title: USA: Mystery bug hits Miami school.
newsitem.headline: Mystery bug hits Miami school.

text.p: A mystery bug has hit a Miami elementary school, afflicting about 100 children, keeping hundreds more from classes and spreading panic among the parents, a schools spokesman said Wednesday.
"It's an unexplained illness. Is it flu, is it a virus, is it airborne, from the water, soil, or sewage? We don't know," Dade County Public Schools spokesman Henry Fraind said.
About 100 pupils at the Gordon School in Countrywalk were taken sick over Tuesday and Wednesday, he said. They suffered vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea.
Many more of the school's 1,500 pupils were staying away.
"I believe half the students are not in today because of the basic hysteria," Fraind said.
"The illness has caused a lot of problems among parents. There's a lot of anxiety and some are very emotional and irrational."
School and health officials were at the school trying to find out what caused the sickness.
